description: P1-6 performance acceptance contract acceptance_v2 (decision D-14; supersedes acceptance_v1 for every real acceptance, Phase 1 xhigh acceptance review findings 1 and 2). Same schema, harness, judge, reference variant, seeds, physics plan, thresholds and evaluator file set as acceptance_v1; the G9 speed gate now times tool-material contact and cutting (window_steps 321-400 of the s512 replay from reset) instead of the pre-contact approach (acceptance_v1: steps 21-120 at N=8/16), with fewer N and pairs to fit the budget. Frozen at the commit that merges it into main (tests/test_acceptance_frozen.py pins its sha256); any change is acceptance_v3.

design.window: G9 replays s512 from reset and times control steps 321-400 (warmup_steps 320, steps 80) at every N. From the WP-17 s512 replays (P1-6 R0 smoke_003 G6 dumps, frozen_v1 and alias_free_v1 identical in these counts): labelling (cutting) runs from step 251 to step 380 (0 -> 37,958 labelled particles; 21,370 at step 320), particle contacts are non-zero at steps 315-364 (first contact 315, total 152,455). The window holds 44 of the 49 contact steps (321-364; 143,022 = 93.8 % of the episode's contact total), 60 cutting steps (321-380; 16,588 new labels, 43.7 % of the final count) and 20 post-cut steps. The first contact steps 315-320 stay in the untimed warm-up, so one-time first-contact work (contact-pool growth, lazy allocations) is not timed; the approach (steps 1-250) is entirely untimed. s15 (held out, not timed) has contacts at steps 322-846 and labels until step 530. A window inside the cutting phase needs >= 314 replay steps per process; a window that started later than 320 would hold fewer contact steps (s512 contacts end at 364).
design.statistics: Kept from acceptance_v1: ABBA pairs in one lock hold per N on the same GPU, the caller's outer clock, N=16 primary (median >= 1.05 and every pair > 1.0, i.e. 3 of 3 pairs: one-sided sign-test false-accept 1/8 under no speed change, stricter than v1's 4 of 5 = 3/16), every-N floor (median >= 0.97), clock tolerance 5 %. Changed for the budget: pairs 5 -> 3 (order BCCBBC) and N {1, 8, 16} -> {1, 16}. N=8 is dropped, not N=1: N=8 and N=16 are both in the saturated regime (P1 performance table: aggregate env-steps/s flat from N=4 on), N=1 is the only unsaturated point and costs 5 % of G9.
design.budget: Estimated before any run from the EXCLUSIVE_GPU workload-A rows (P1_PERFORMANCE_TABLE.md, exclusive_001, alias_free_v1 = the reference variant, pre-contact per-step medians N=1 0.098 s, N=8 0.571 s, N=16 1.180 s; per-process overhead 13-15 s; smoke_003 shows episode mode costs about the same per step as throughput). G9 run (400 steps): N=1 52 s, N=16 487 s; G9 total 6 x (52 + 487) s = 54 min. Physics plan (unchanged from v1): G6 6 runs x 261 s = 26 min, G7 2 x 362 s = 12 min, G4 4 x 57 s = 4 min, G8 2 x 75 s = 2.5 min, = 44.5 min. One acceptance = 98 GPU-min exclusive = 1.64 GPU-h; x1.3 shared (LR-A foreign SM mean 35 %) = 2.1 h; x1.5 = 2.46 h <= 2.5 h. Largest lock-hold block: G9 N=16, 49 min exclusive, 73 min at x1.5, 90 min at x1.85. Rejected: the v1 design with this window (5 pairs, N 1/8/16) = 130 min of G9 alone (N=16 block 81 min exclusive, 122 min at x1.5) and 2.9 GPU-h per acceptance; 3 pairs with N 1/8/16 = 2.04 GPU-h exclusive, 2.65 h at x1.3. The contact-phase step cost of alias_free_v1 was not measured before this declaration (P1 table windows are pre-contact); if it is higher the budget scales with it. Under heavy co-tenancy (smoke_003: x2.2) one acceptance exceeds 2.5 h and its absolute rows are SHARED_GPU; the caller's GPU admission should wait instead.

thresholds.reset_p95_rule: G9:<n>:reset on the per-side medians of reset p95 over all ABBA processes at N. Both sides EXCLUSIVE_GPU: FAIL if C > reset_p95_ratio_max x B + reset_p95_slack_ms. Either side SHARED_GPU (or UNKNOWN): PASS if C <= ratio x B + reset_p95_slack_ms; WARN shared_gpu_reset_bimodality (verdict.warnings, not a failure) if C <= ratio x B + reset_p95_shared_slack_ms; FAIL above that. Reason: on a shared GPU each process settles in a ~1 ms or ~7 ms reset mode independent of the variant (smoke_001: B 1.7 ms vs C 7.1 ms at N=1, reversed at N=2).
thresholds.candidate_reported: VRAM peak (nvidia-smi per-process samples of the process tree, allocator fallback), reset p95 and the per-step walls of performance.phases are measured inside the process under test (candidate-reported, not independently verified); only env-steps/s has the caller's outer clock
thresholds.rules: G9 per N: median over the ABBA pairs of candidate/baseline outer-clock env-steps/s; primary N median >= primary_median_min with >= primary_pairs_above_1 pairs > 1.0; every N median >= all_median_min; max VRAM peak C <= vram_ratio_max x max B + vram_slack_mib; median reset p95 per reset_p95_rule; every G9 run |inner/outer - 1| <= clock_tolerance; G9:window: in every episode dump of the window_check plans for the G9 seeds (both sides, every repeat) the G9 window holds >= min_contact_steps steps with non-zero particle contacts and >= min_new_labels new labelled particles (candidate below while the baseline meets it: FAIL; the baseline below: BLOCKED); performance.phases: per-phase median step walls per side and their ratio, descriptive only

physics.position_rule: full episodes: the final maximum position difference vs Native is compared with the band file's high value per seed (or the reference variant's own value for that seed in the same acceptance, whichever is larger). mode descriptive: a WARN in verdict.warnings and the gate values, never a gate result; mode gate: a PHYSICS check. band v2 is the pre-declared 10-replay one-sided 99 % log-normal bound; it stays descriptive in acceptance_v2.
physics.contact_total_rel_tol_note: Kept at 0.02 (acceptance_v1 raised it from 0.01 after P1-6 R0 smoke_003, before any baseline): frozen_v1 vs alias_free_v1 s15 contact totals differ by 0.51 % (s512 0.03 %), so 0.01 left only a 2x margin for a known-good change, and G7 has one baseline run per acceptance (no spread term).
physics.rules: episodes (hard gates): final codes = Native, labelled counts = Native, sample invariants (finite, digits <= 2, no digit rewrites, invalid_reason 0), frozen TRIM evaluator PASS on 2 frames and on the Native sample series, per-env contact total within max(contact_total_rel_tol, 2 x baseline spread) of the baseline median; position band per position_band.mode; samestate: per recorded sample identical non-zero impulse sets (both reruns) and stats[4], impulse max relative difference <= impulse_rel_tol; short replay final codes equal, positions within replay_position_tol_m, contact totals within contact_total_rel_tol; a candidate failure where the baseline fails the same check for the same seed is BLOCKED
